title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Priya Patel
commits: Add initial RAG templates and example JSON template
Add tool-calling quickstarts (Python + TypeScript) and example playbook
Docs: add RAG guide, templates page, FAQ and quickstart site content
Fix: update sidebar so quickstarts appear under 'Guides > Agents'
Add integration tests for example playbook and CI linting adjustments
description: Motivation: provide first-class developer docs and examples for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents and tool-calling workflows so teams can quickly prototype and standardize agent patterns. What this PR does: 1) adds a new 'RAG' guide under Guides > Agents with conceptual overview, trade-offs, and recommended templates; 2) adds a templates.md page with several reusable JSON/YAML templates (document retrieval + prompt templating + response handlers); 3) ships two quickstarts for tool-calling agents (Python and TypeScript) with minimal example code and step-by-step setup; 4) includes an example playbook and a small playground configuration to exercise agent templates locally; 5) updates site sidebars and images to expose the new pages; 6) small CI additions to run the example playbook smoke test. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG conceptual guide and templates - [x] Add Python quickstart and example code - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and example code - [x] Add example playbook + test harness - [x] Update docs site sidebar and images - [x] CI: add smoke test and linting exemptions for example files Known limitations: templates are intentionally minimal and documented as starting points; production integrations should wire in auth/KV/cache per customer needs. Related: ENG-7421 (internal evals), DOC-512 (doc milestone).
review_comments: Ethan Zhang: Nice work — docs read well. Left two suggestions: (1) clarify caching/KV expectation in the templates; (2) remove hardcoded local paths in the python quickstart. See inline comments.
Priya Patel: Thanks Ethan — addressed both. Template now includes a 'caching' section and python quickstart uses relative paths and env var examples.
Lena Morales: Can we add a short note about cost implications of different retrieval chunk sizes? Also suggested a small perf note about batching for multi-query workloads.

Priya Patel: Added a 'cost & perf considerations' subsection with guidance on chunk sizes, desired_recall vs cost tradeoffs, and a recommended batching stanza. Marked the perf note with a 'performance' callout in the templates page.
Samir Rao: CI smoke test failed on first run due to dependency mismatch; re-ran after pinning test dependency to match CI image and all checks passed.
release_notes: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts: new developer guides and examples for RAG agents (Python & TypeScript), example playbook, CI smoke test. Recommended for SDK users who want a quick prototype path.
